_note: Keyword evidence for SUGGESTING a tax section from a bill. A suggestion is never an eligibility decision; the engine and HR decide. Edit freely.

caveats: Rent receipts over ₹1,00,000/year need the landlord's PAN.
HRA exemption exists only if salary has an HRA component; old regime only.
Exemption is per meal and only for employer-provided vouchers; state the number of meals.
Only the TUITION component of full-time education in India qualifies (80C, old regime, max 2 children).
Development, transport, hostel, donation and other fees are not deductible.
80D covers PREMIUM (non-cash) and ₹5,000 preventive check-up; a hospital treatment bill is not an 80D premium.
80C total is capped at ₹1,50,000 across all instruments (old regime).
Self-occupied interest limit ₹2,00,000 (old regime). The certificate has separate interest and principal figures - enter each as its own claim.
Only INTEREST is deductible (80E), for up to 8 years from start of repayment; lender must be a bank/financial institution.
80EEB applies only to loans sanctioned 1-Apr-2019 to 31-Mar-2023.
Employer EV lease / reimbursement tax treatment is NOT auto-computed; payroll/tax team must decide.
